summary: @servicetitan/measure-sheet-data preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execFileSync a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file (math_init.js) shipped in the tarball. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated: setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifier mangling and per-function string dictionaries, and math_init.js uses a rotated string array (WV8StW shift routine over n7gIxM) plus character-code reconstruction, rendering the payload's behavior and network destinations opaque without execution. The package's declared purpose is `Measurement data for glass for ServiceTitan`, which has no relationship to installing an alternate JavaScript runtime or executing an opaque bundled payload at install time. Bun is used specifically to run the payload outside of Node, evading Node-oriented install-time inspection. The `@servicetitan` scope on public npm, combined with a hostile preinstall unrelated to the advertised repository, matches the dependency-confusion / scope-hijack shape targeting corporate private-scope builds.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
